trial_court: Family Court No. 1, Pune (Petition No. E-32/97 and Petition No. D-44/97)
case_name: Anita Krishnakumar Kachba vs Krishnakumar Ramchandra Kachba
facts_of_case: The parties got married in 1991 and have two sons. The husband suspected the wife's character and made enquiries about her lifestyle prior to their marriage. He claimed she had illicit relations with a college colleague, which led to daily matrimonial bickerings.

legal_principles.principle: A mother is entitled to the custody of her minor children, considering their welfare.
legal_principles.held: She being the mother, was entitled to a custody of the minor children considering their welfare.

legal_principles.principle: A subsequent event during the pendency of an appeal can affect the outcome.
legal_principles.held: In her submission, order of restoration of appeal will relate back to the date of presentation of the petition as such the marriage of the respondent with Ms. Sheetal being during the pendency of the appeal cannot be said to be legal and valid in the eye of law.

outcome.final_order: The trial court's decree dissolving the marriage and granting permanent alimony was upheld. The husband was directed to continue paying Rs. 500/- per month to the wife, in addition to Rs. 100/- towards maintenance.

use_for_drafting: representing clients in family court proceedings
